title: empty --why is allowed on accepted and pending refs
description:
Researcher first-pass.

register accepts --why ''. A reject still has to be write-nothing, but a junk accepted or pending row with a blank why can be created.

Product rule: accepted and pending require a non-empty why. Empty why is only valid for a reject (or for not writing the row at all).

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented on cursor/operator-cli-2020 (PR #54). Behavior specified in features/operator-cli.feature register scenarios; verified with npm run test:bdd:operator-cli (27 scenarios green).
